highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.147.0 previews Skia m147 with variable fonts, animated WebP encoding, and new drawing APIs.
highlights_body: This v4 preview also introduces SKPathBuilder, color font palettes, zero-copy SKStream data access, and new Linux and Tizen assets. It raises the WebAssembly floor to .NET 8 and includes API and runtime changes that require migration from v3.

breaking.title: Assembly version moves to 4.x
breaking.body: SkiaSharp.dll now reports assembly version 4.147.0.0 instead of 3.119.0.0. Update strong-name binding redirects and any version checks before adopting the preview.

breaking.title: GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo is replaced by GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo
breaking.body: GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo now uses the consistently cased GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo type, and the old type loses its value-equality interface and operators. Update type references and equality checks.

breaking.title: Parameterless SKFont uses an empty typeface
breaking.body: A parameterless SKFont no longer resolves the platform default while drawing; its typeface is SKTypeface.Empty, so text measures to zero and does not render. Construct SKFont with SKTypeface.Default when text should use the platform default.

breaking.title: WebAssembly native assets require .NET 8 or later
breaking.body: Native assets for pre-.NET 8 Emscripten versions are removed. Move Blazor WebAssembly and Uno WebAssembly applications to .NET 8 or later before upgrading.

breaking.title: Tizen 32-bit native assets are removed
breaking.body: The Skia m147 update drops Tizen arm and x86 native builds. Move Tizen deployments to arm64 or x64.

bullets.lead: Skia advances from m132 through m147
bullets.detail: The bundled renderer moves across fifteen milestones and adopts immutable SkPath internals, with SKPathBuilder providing the new managed mutation API.

bullets.lead: Variable fonts and color font palettes
bullets.detail: SKTypeface and HarfBuzzSharp expose variation axes, named instances, design coordinates, palette selection, and per-color overrides for variable and color fonts.
SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface gain overloads that accept SKSamplingOptions, restoring explicit filtering control when compositing surfaces.
SKWebpEncoder can encode frame sequences with durations into animated WebP output using span-based overloads.
SKStream.GetData returns the backing SKData when the native stream can expose it directly, avoiding an intermediate copy.

bullets.lead: Additional document, GPU, mask filter, and HarfBuzz APIs
bullets.detail: Adds XPS document options, per-resource GPU flushes, shader-backed mask filters, HBColor, and previously missing HarfBuzz wrappers.

bullets.lead: Default typeface resolution no longer crashes on Android API 36
bullets.detail: Default typefaces now resolve through the managed font manager with an empty-typeface fallback when no platform face is available.

bullets.lead: SKPath finalization no longer depends on builder collection order
bullets.detail: Disposal avoids flushing an SKPathBuilder after it has already been finalized, preventing a native crash on the finalizer thread.

bullets.lead: Color-font and variation span operations are hardened
bullets.detail: Undersized variation buffers now follow Skia's all-or-nothing writes correctly, and SKTypeface.ContainsGlyphs no longer recurses until a stack overflow.

bullets.lead: Android SKGLView resumes rendering after tab switches
bullets.detail: Reattaching an SKGLView in a MAUI TabBar no longer leaves the OpenGL view blank.
Adds linux-bionic native packages and Tizen arm64 and x64 builds while retiring Tizen's 32-bit targets.

bullets.lead: Apple target frameworks accept the base 26.0 workload
bullets.detail: Library packages target the 26.0 Apple TFMs, while applications use unversioned TFMs so installed workloads select the matching SDK.

contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Linux Bionic native assets, PolySharp support for legacy target frameworks, and WebAssembly packaging work
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Skia milestone updates, variable fonts, default typeface resolution, the SKPath finalizer fix, and Uno sample maintenance

harfbuzz_summary: Adds variable-font and color-palette APIs, introduces HBColor for the native BGRA representation, and fills gaps in the public HarfBuzzSharp wrappers.

v4.147.0-preview.1.1.summary: Opens the v4 preview line with Skia m147, SKPathBuilder, variable and color-font APIs, explicit surface sampling, and new Linux and Tizen assets.

v4.147.0-preview.2.1.summary: Adds animated WebP encoding and zero-copy SKStream data access, fixes the SKPath finalizer crash, and broadens Apple workload compatibility.

v4.147.0-preview.3.1.summary: Adds HBColor and missing API wrappers, raises WebAssembly native assets to .NET 8, and refreshes bundled native dependencies.
